rightsRisk: CC BY grants only rights the licensor has authority to grant; no separate third-party texture claim was found in the supplied package or model page.
modifications: Excluded the source Sword2_1, Scutum_04_01, and Scabbard objects so runtime procedural equipment remains authoritative
Applied uniform metre normalization to 1.78 m
Reduced the armour shoulder outline to the 0.46 m contract limit
Built project-humanoid-v1 from the unrigged T-pose source
Applied deterministic segmented skin weights with rigid chest armour, upper-arm shoulder plates, limited skirt weights, and restrained dangle weights
Added fitted dark-red undertunic thigh layers to avoid an exposed wedge silhouette in the mounted pose
Added hand, back, head, pelvis, foot, and sole socket bones
Downsampled embedded maps to actual 2K, 1K, and 512 maximum dimensions
remainingUncertainties: The source FBX contains disconnected meshes, no armature, no weights, no actions, and emits excess-layer warnings during Blender import.
The mounted thigh and skirt silhouette passed the isolated 12:32 asset review provisionally but must be validated against the actual saddle in the browser.
If saddle validation exposes gaps or clipping, the corrective path is manual topology and weight refinement in Blender, not runtime non-uniform scaling.
